first-idea.name: Te whakaaro tuatahi
first-idea.line: Te kōrero tuatahi rawa, i mua i te whai waehere.
first-board.name: Te papa tuatahi
first-board.line: He papa e whai ana i tōna ake hanga: ngā kāri, ngā pou, te toia, ngā kaupapa.
team-roles.name: Te rōpū me ngā tūranga
team-roles.line: Ngā kōtaha kaiwhakahaere, ngā tauira rōpū, ngā mokowā me te mahi a ia tangata.
install.name: Te tāuta me ngā tukunga
install.line: He zip e taea e tētahi hoa te tāuta, te whakahou-ā-tinana, ngā hongere me te hoki whakamuri.
usage-saver.name: Te kaitiaki whakamahinga
usage-saver.line: Ine i te utu o ngā whakahaerenga, kia kōmaki te waehere, kia mau tō tepe.
friends.name: Ngā hoa me te tiritiri
friends.line: Ngā karere tūmataiti, he hononga hunahuna, ngā pōwhiri, ngā tūranga me ngā kaupapa tiritahi.
languages.name: Ngā reo
languages.line: Ia kupu o ia mata i tētahi kōnae reo, ko te Tati tuatahi.
ai-tester.name: Kaiwhakamātau AI
ai-tester.line: Ka tirotiro tuatahi tētahi kaiwhakamātau i ia tukunga, ka whakaatu i tāna i kite ai.
website.name: Te pae tukutuku
website.line: aigile.lol, te whārangi tīmatanga me tēnei rārangi wā.
streaming.name: Te kōrero me te rere ora
streaming.line: Discord, Twitch, OBS, te aratau kaiwhakaatu, ngā GIF me ngā emoji.
no-ai.name: Te putanga kore AI
no-ai.line: He papa mō te hunga e waehere ana me te kore AI, me ngā papa tūmatanui.
night-watch.name: Te kaitiaki pō
night-watch.line: Ka whakahaere tētahi kaitiaki me tētahi Scrum Master i ngā rōpū i a koe e moe ana.
p-more.name: Ngā mea katoa atu
p-more.line: Ngā whakaaro iti e tatari tonu ana i tō rātou wā.
p-android.name: Te waea me Android
p-android.line: Toro atu ki tō papa mai i te waea, kātahi he taupānga Android ake.
p-release.name: Te alpha me tua atu
p-release.line: Te alpha kati, te pae ora, kātahi te beta.
p-languages.name: Ētahi atu reo
p-languages.line: 130 ngā reo, me tētahi aratau rumaki mō ngā ākonga.
p-engines.name: Ētahi atu pūkaha AI
p-engines.line: Kōwhiria a Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor rānei mō ia kaiwhakahaere.
p-pro.name: Te tikanga ngaio
p-pro.line: Ngā tūtohu tūpono, ngā kēti whakakotahi, ngā kāri aituā me ngā tiaki.
p-self.name: Te tiaki i a koe
p-self.line: Te aratau ngenge, ngā whakamahara tiaki-whaiaro me te 4:20.
p-servers.name: Ngā tūmau me te whānui
p-servers.line: Ngā tautuhinga tūmau ao, ngā tūranga me te whakamahere mō te tipu.
p-livestream.name: Ngā taapiri rere ora
p-livestream.line: Te kōrero Twitch, ngā emoji ake me tētahi tirohanga ora tūmatanui.
